text_block_list.text:
Seeing how exhausted King Halo was,
I decided to take her to the infirmary to rest.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"A King wouldn't get worn out by something like this, but...
Well, I'll do as you say just this once..."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Mmm, huh?
Where could this be...?

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: My King, have you finally awoken?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right! I am King,
a magnificent being destined to reign supreme!"

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you are the one destined to become
the first sovereign of this land of Tracen.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Now, let us proclaim the founding of a new kingdom!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, you don't even need to tell me.
Now listen closely—!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Here and now, I declare the founding of
a kingdom by King, for King: King Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Now, bow down and revere the First King, King Halo!

text_block_list.name: Entourage
text_block_list.text:
King♪ King♪
King Kingdom♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oooohohohohoho!
How wonderfuuuuul!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
First, perhaps I'll build
100 King-exclusive brand boutiques—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...
Oh, where is this...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? My body feels light.
My fatigue is gone too...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm feeling great right now.
Like I could go for a run this second!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu,
let's resume training right away!

Having recovered thanks to the rest, King Halo
confidently left the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
—Messenger, incoming messenger!
The forces of our neighbor, the Seiun Kingdom,
are invading our lands!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, foolish... I'll turn the tables on them.
All units, prepare for battle――!

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's impossible! There are only three of us, including King,
against an army of a hundred thousand~

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
T-Three people, as in just us?!
That's not even a country anymore!

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What are you going to do, King?
Maybe they'll forgive you if you apologize.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I absolutely hate that! Just picturing Sky-san's smug, triumphant smile makes my blood boil!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they're already swarming in!?
A-At this rate—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: The King Kingdom is ruined—!!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa...
Oh, my...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like I just had
a terrifying nightmare...
Because she was tormented by nightmares, King Halo was unable to get enough rest.
